test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 19 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following gases are evolved at the anode and the cathode, respectively, during electrolytic decomposition of aqueous sodium chloride?

options.text: H2 gas at the anode and O₂ gas at the cathode.
O₂ gas at the anode and H₂ gas at the cathode.
Cl₂ gas at the anode and H₂ gas at the cathode.
H₂ gas at the anode and Cl₂ gas at the cathode.

solution:
The correct answer is__** Cl2 gas at the anode and H2**____** gas at the cathode**__.
